snapshot.name: Asian Paints Ltd
snapshot.about: Asian Paints is the largest home decor company in India. The 80+yr old company has major brands like Asian Paints, Apco, etc under its umbrella. The co. is into wall paints, wall coverings, waterproofing, texture painting, wall stickers, mechanized tools, adhesives, modular kitchens, sanitaryware, lightings, soft furnishings, and uPVC windows.

latest_quarter.source: screener quarterly table (standardised from exchange filing)
latest_quarter.headline: Revenue +17% YoY, EBITDA +4%, PAT +7%, margin 15.6% (-2.0pp YoY)

5-yr cumulative CFO is 1.09× PAT (₹22,795 Cr vs ₹20,943 Cr)
5-yr free cash flow ₹15,070 Cr; negative in 0 of 5 years

business_mix.what_it_does: Asian Paints Limited exists to beautify, transform, and preserve all spaces and objects bringing happiness to the world through its paints, coatings, home decor, and related services.

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management repeatedly guides for an EBITDA/PBDIT margin band of 18% to 20%.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating profit margins dipped to 16.0% in Sep 2026, failing to hold the guided range.

promises.credibility: Management frequently reiterates a confident EBITDA margin target of 18-20%, but actual operating margins fell short at 16% in Sep 2026.

bull: Strong capital efficiency with a ROCE of 26.3% and an ROE of 21.8%.
Investments of ₹6,389 Cr comfortably exceed the total borrowings of ₹4,596 Cr.
Consistent free cash generation totaling ₹15,070 Cr over 5 years with zero negative years.
bear: Revenue growth has slowed significantly from a 10% CAGR over 5 years to 1% over 3 years.
The latest quarter Sep 2026 EBITDA margin fell to 15.6%, missing the 18% to 20% guidance band.
Debt-to-equity increased to 0.21 from 0.13 three periods ago.
